name: Lichtenberg Figure
desc: A dielectric-breakdown burn that accretes from a hot seed, forking into ever-finer feathery tendrils that spread to fill the frame like captured lightning frozen in acrylic, then softly regrows — as violet-white electric plasma, cyan captured-acrylic, amber woodburn, white frost-on-glass, or a mono ink print.

density.doc: grow rate + how densely the burn fills the frame

energy.doc: vein glow, hot-core bloom, frontier shimmer amplitude

eta.doc: breakdown straightness: low=fat branchy tree, high=whip-thin sparse channels

style.doc: render philosophy: violet-white plasma / cyan captured-acrylic / amber burn on wood / white frost-on-glass / mono ink print
